question.en: Discuss the transition from GATT to the World Trade Organization (WTO). How did this shift impact the scope of international trade regulations?
question.hi: Discuss the transition from GATT to the World Trade Organization (WTO). How did this shift impact the scope of international trade regulations?

modelAnswer.en: The transition from GATT (1947) to WTO (1995) marked a shift from a provisional treaty to a permanent institutional framework. GATT focused on goods, while the WTO expanded the scope to include services (GATS) and intellectual property (TRIPS). It also introduced a more robust dispute settlement mechanism.
